name: VERCEL DEPLOY
summary: Audit, optimise, and deploy Vercel projects: cost and performance audits via live metrics, route-level investigation, caching strategy, function usage, and ISR/middleware/image optimisation.
prevents: Runaway Vercel costs, slow routes, over-provisioned functions, and missed caching opportunities that compound on every deployment.

cursor.rule_description: Use when deploying to Vercel, optimising a live Vercel project, investigating slow or expensive routes, or reducing function invocations and build minutes.
cursor.skill_description: agentgrammar VERCEL DEPLOY — metrics-first audit and deploy workflow for Vercel: cost, performance, caching, ISR, middleware, images. Use when the user invokes /agentgrammar-vercel-deploy or works on a Vercel project.
